 Raphael Claus to referee Corinthians v São Paulo in Brasileirão derby 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Corinthians face São Paulo on Wednesday at 21:30 at Vila Belmiro in round 34 of the Brasileirão. Raphael Claus has been appointed as the referee for the derby.
 According to Meu Timao, this will be the 47th Corinthians match overseen by Claus since their first in 2011. Under him, Corinthians have 21 wins, 10 draws and 15 defeats, and their players have received 97 yellows and six reds.
 OneFootball Videos
 In 2026, Claus handled three Corinthians fixtures. In the Paulista, he took charge of the loss to Palmeiras in the first phase and the 1-1 draw with Portuguesa in the quarter-finals. In the league, he refereed the 2-0 win over Red Bull Bragantino in August in Bragança Paulista.
 The Majestoso officiating team includes assistants Daniel Luis Marques and Alex Ang Ribeiro, both from São Paulo. Denis da Silva Ribeiro Serafim, from Alagoas, is fourth official, with Daiane Muniz, also from São Paulo, on VAR.
 Corinthians sit 18th on 36 points, one fewer than Internacional, Vitória and Vasco da Gama, the first three above the drop. Victory could take them out of the Z4, depending on rivals’ results. São Paulo are 10th on 43 points.
 Source: Meu Timao
